resolution: Removed the 'on the editor bus · durable, seq-ordered' status line from EventBusPopover — flavor text I myself introduced in req_2424. It's a permanently-green 'all good' narration, the exact same theater as the ERR/WARN badge we already killed, just dressed in fancier engineer words ('durable, seq-ordered'). The '{total} events' pill already proves the bus is live, and the durable-vs-local-fallback distinction is internal plumbing that doesn't affect the user's work (their authoring state persists via persistView independently of the bus log). Removed the whole HW_EventSummary status block for BOTH states (the healthy narration and the fallback jargon) plus the now-dead isHostBacked() import and  var; the popover now shows the event count, undoable/redo, and the event rows — nothing narrated. accentFor stays (header icon). Parses clean via esbuild transform; not shipped (live session). Sha 5ea4406ca.
